notState.reason: A custom command has no catalog choices by design; this muted capability advisory is not failed or empty catalog content.
Choosing an agent is a configuration prerequisite, not a successful empty model catalog.
A non-catalog agent cannot offer structured launch choices; the muted capability advisory is not a read failure.
The catalog chooses a free-text model field or listed-model selector according to its input policy.
The unavailable saved model remains an option to show the stored value; it is not a catalog-read error.
Only discoverable catalogs expose Refresh models; this is optional capability-driven control presence.
The refresh button labels an in-flight discovery operation rather than replacing content with a loading state.
The muted saved-model advisory explains an unavailable persisted choice without disguising a read failure.
The model choice is shadowed by CLI arguments; this is a muted source-of-value advisory.
Boolean options offer On and Off instead of catalog string choices; this is ordinary form composition.
The option value comes from CLI arguments; this is a muted source-of-value advisory.
The parent optionally supplies an inherited-choice reset control; it is not a loading, empty or error render.
The saved but unavailable agent remains an option so its identity is visible, not a failed agent-list state.
The save-scope selector is present only when a draft can be saved, not as loading, empty or error content.
The primary button describes whether this launch also saves its recipe; this is a label swap, not content state.
This swaps the optional-conversation selector's placeholder according to action, not content state.
The button label indicates a name-generation operation in progress, not a section loading state.
The suggested-name output appears after generation; it is an optional result field, not an empty-state render.
The muted note explains repository recipe precedence, not a loading, empty or error state.
An unavailable saved agent remains a selectable value; its option is not an agent-read failure.
Only commit-message generation offers the configured custom command; this is an action-specific choice.
The branch-name recipe has its own generation controls; this is section composition, not content state.
The conversation-name recipe has its own generation controls; its real session-empty state is witnessed separately.
The working dot is an in-button progress indicator for an accepted launch, not a content loading state.
The launch options trigger is disabled during a launch; this swaps an optional control, not content state.
This toast confirms a successful agent launch, not a loading, empty or error state.
The status wrapper announces the Loading AI settings NoticeLine; it is not a separate content state.
The status wrapper announces the Detecting agents NoticeLine; it is not a separate content state.
The agent select appears only when choices exist; the zero-choice branch is represented by EmptyState.
This guard selects the already witnessed loading or fallback error render, rather than an independent state.
The status wrapper announces the catalog-loading NoticeLine; it is not a separate content state.
The working dot is an in-button progress indicator while generation is running, not content loading.
The Stop button is available only during generation; its presence is an optional control, not a content state.
The context menu is local overlay visibility, not loading, empty, or error content.
The Generate dialog is local overlay visibility, not loading, empty, or error content.
The agent selector appears only when usable choices exist; the zero-choice branch has its own EmptyState.
The status wrapper announces the Detecting agents NoticeLine; it is not a separate content state.
A populated launch form is ordinary ready content, not an independent loading, empty, or error state.
This Cancel control appears only when preview failed before a form exists; the optional control is not a separate state.
The status wrapper announces the Loading NoticeLine; it is not a separate content state.
A non-authoritative model-discovery result is a muted advisory that saved choices were kept, not an error state.
